files_read: measurement_architecture_reading_report.md (sections: parametric persistence, stability band, forensic audit, meta-logical audit)
keyword scan across all *.md for incident-shaped prose
symptom: A data-completeness verification stage prints 'Verification passed' and a per-item validation stage prints no failures, for an item whose entire measurement grid is unfilled — 32 of 32 slots absent and zero per-item checks executed. Both stages emit exactly the success line they emit when they have checked something and found it sound.
mechanism_as_described: Two independent sites produce a success that reports on nothing. (a) A repair stage runs before verification and fills every absent grid slot, either with a fixed mid-scale default value or with a value imputed from priors. Verification then tests the grid for completeness — but its input has been made complete by the stage immediately upstream, so the test cannot come out any other way. Its pass reports the repair, not the data. The report now states this in the pass line itself: completeness is guaranteed by the repair stage, and the check is non-discriminating after it. (b) The per-item validation iterates over the item's authored classifications and checks each one; with none authored the iteration body never runs and the enclosing check succeeds having run zero checks. Downstream of both, a structural-pattern verdict was computed over the grid, so a verdict could rest on values that were generated by the repair rather than authored, with nothing at the read site marking which slots were which. The described remedy has three parts: the filling was retired so an absent slot now stays open; each stage prints a provenance split of the grid (authored / filled-at-default / imputed-from-priors / absent) so the origin of every value travels with it; and the pattern verdict now abstains with a named reason instead of returning a value computed over unfilled ground.
detection_path: Visible in the report text only after the filling was disabled and each stage was made to print its own input provenance. With the fill off, the same verification stage still printed a pass over a grid of 32 absent slots, and the same per-item stage still printed no failures over zero executed checks — which is what shows neither stage had ever been discriminating. The annotations naming the verification non-discriminating and the zero-check result 'not a clean pass' were added at that point and appear in every one of the five reports snapshotted here.
consequence: For as long as the filling was live, a verification of data completeness and a per-item validation both reported success over values the system had generated for itself, and those values were indistinguishable at every downstream read from values an author supplied. The affected reads carry a success line whose real meaning is 'nothing was examined' rather than 'what was examined was sound' — and the two are the same string. The residue is still visible in the snapshot: the item is fully unmeasured, and both stages still print success, now qualified.

extraction_notes.unit_is_incident_not_audit: The directory's subject is a datum snapshot of five generated reports plus a closing ruling about where the framework sits. The unit describes an incident the report prose reports, not the datum or the ruling.
extraction_notes.selection_rule: Fullest DESCRIBED mechanism — a unit can only carry the mechanism the prose states — tiebroken by realized consequence over caught-before-it-mattered. The selected incident is the only one whose prose names both the producing site and why the check could not fail; the alternatives are named as conditions without a stated mechanism.

alternatives_not_extracted.what: A parameter-sweep artifact carries no identifier of the data it was computed over, so a consumer cannot tell whether its values describe the current data or a superseded set; the report suppresses rendering rather than showing them.
alternatives_not_extracted.why_not: Reported as a one-line condition with a named remedy; the prose states the missing field and the consequence but not the mechanism by which the artifact came to lack it. Thinner described mechanism.

alternatives_not_extracted.what: Relationship edges between items render with unknown identity and unknown strength, and the report states that the origin marker distinguishing a story's own claim from a system-derived relationship is not carried, so every edge must be treated as possibly derived.
alternatives_not_extracted.why_not: A declared absence of a provenance field rather than a reported instance of it misleading a read; no realized consequence stated in this document.

alternatives_not_extracted.what: An authored resistance field is absent and the failure analysis substitutes a default of 0.0, then prints the resulting analysis alongside measured quantities.
alternatives_not_extracted.why_not: The substitution is annotated inline at the read site ('MISSING (using default 0.0)'), so the prose reports the honest form rather than an instance of the value passing as measured. Smaller consequence, and the same family as the selected incident.

extraction_notes.detection_path_is_inferred: The document shows the annotated post-repair state rather than narrating a discovery. The detection path above is reconstructed from what the annotations assert; flagged so the adjudicator can check it against the source.
